meta.description: Mapping table: component_group / component_key → state-pattern scenario IDs

S1.name: NEW Badge — Hide After Viewed
S1.abstract_pattern: Novelty indicator clears after user engagement

S2.name: Dismissible Announcements
S2.abstract_pattern: One-time or limited-show content dismissed by user

S4.name: Pinned Items
S4.abstract_pattern: User-marked favorites surfaced in priority position

S5.name: Onboarding Checklist
S5.abstract_pattern: Progressive task completion tracked per user

S6.name: Search History
S6.abstract_pattern: Recent queries stored and suggested on repeat use

S8.name: Folder Expand/Collapse
S8.abstract_pattern: Collapsible section state persists within session

reasoning.S1: Form fields with validation status can show 'new/updated' indicators (e.g., new required field added)
reasoning.S5: Onboarding: guide user through form fields step-by-step (fill name → fill phone → submit)
reasoning.S7: Remember last-used form variant or input mode preference

Input/Form.not_applicable_reason: Input fields are not pinnable items; no collapsible hierarchy

reasoning.S2: Headers/footers host dismissible banners, announcements, system notices
reasoning.S8: Sections within layout (accordion, expandable panels) need expand/collapse memory

Layout.not_applicable_reason: Layout containers are structural, not user-navigable items

reasoning.S2: Action buttons can trigger dismissible tooltips or first-time-use hints
reasoning.S5: Onboarding: track whether user has performed key actions (clicked button X)
reasoning.S7: Remember last-used action or navigation path preference

Navigation/Action.not_applicable_reason: Buttons are not browsable items with history; no collapsible structure

reasoning.S6: Search bar directly maps to search history scenario
reasoning.S7: Filter tabs directly map to filter preference memory

Search/Filter.not_applicable_reason: Filters are controls, not pinnable content; no collapsible hierarchy

reasoning.S1: Cards/list items are prime candidates for NEW/updated badges (new product, new order)
reasoning.S2: Dismissible banners or tips within card sections
reasoning.S3: Recently viewed cards/items (recent products, recent orders)
reasoning.S4: Pin favorite cards to top (pinned products, pinned orders)
reasoning.S8: Grouped lists with collapsible sections (order groups, category groups)

Cards/Lists.not_applicable_reason: Cards/Lists are the most versatile group for interaction patterns

reasoning.S1: Info boxes can show NEW badge for fresh notifications or updates
reasoning.S2: Infobox, helper text, success popups are classic dismissible content

Info/Feedback.not_applicable_reason: Feedback elements are transient, not navigable/pinnable/searchable

reasoning.S1: Special components (QR container, payment options) can show 'new feature' badges
reasoning.S2: Dismissible setup guides or first-time tips for special components
reasoning.S5: Onboarding for complex flows (upload area guide, payment setup steps)

Special.not_applicable_reason: Special components rarely involve search functionality
